name.fr-FR: Défense de la tradition et des saints Pères
name.en-US: Defence of Tradition and of the Holy Fathers
name.pt-BR: Defesa da tradição e dos santos Padres

description.fr-FR: Réponse en treize livres à l’oratorien Richard Simon et à ses Remarques sur les Pères : la tradition, les interprétations des Pères sur l’Écriture, la grâce, la prédestination, la Trinité et la divinité du Christ, contre l’usage critique et rationaliste de la patristique. Composée vers 1702-1704, publiée en 1763. Édition Lachat (1862).
description.en-US: A reply in thirteen books to Richard Simon and his remarks on the Fathers: tradition, the Fathers’ interpretation of Scripture, grace, predestination, the Trinity and the divinity of Christ, against a critical and rationalist use of the patristic tradition. Composed around 1702-04 and published in 1763. Lachat edition (1862).
description.pt-BR: Resposta em treze livros ao oratoriano Richard Simon e às suas observações sobre os Padres: a tradição, as interpretações dos Padres sobre a Escritura, a graça, a predestinação, a Trindade e a divindade de Cristo, contra o uso crítico e racionalista da patrística. Composta por volta de 1702-1704 e publicada em 1763. Edição Lachat (1862).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume IV, pages 001-015. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
